description: Canonical MuDemocracy governance package. At v1.1.0 it refines field aiGuidance to align with the published deliberating-decisions and decision-recording guides — notably correcting the rationale sentence-count guidance from 'one to three' to 'two to four' sentences, and sharpening alternatives-considered negativeGuidance to discourage 'none' responses more explicitly. At v1.2.0, the srs rev-6 composition-cutover (srs#523/#524, rfc-decision-92d2da05 + rfc-decision-c8704763): DocumentView renamed to Composition (document-views/ -> compositions/ dir, $schema repointed) and the type-query SectionSource's semanticObjectType key renamed to typeKey (KEYED namespace/name, unchanged values) -- a mechanical rename only, no view's shape (type-query vs container-subset) changed. srs#525 (SectionSource -> DiscoveryQuery collapse, rfc-decision-cce3c00e + rfc-decision-9ee14517): type-query sections migrated to discovery-query (typeKey -> query.typeNamespace/query.typeName, unchanged values; containerScope/excludeLifecycleStates preserved) -- again a mechanical shape migration only, applied uniformly across 1.0.0/1.1.0/1.2.0, no new package version cut. At v1.2.1 (srs#548): the loose package/ tree here is unchanged from 1.2.0 (already current: protocol unprefixed per srs#379/rfc-decision-a270e98a, exportConfig/discovery-query per srs#540/srs#525) -- republished solely because the seed/empty-governance-document.srsj shipped alongside 1.2.0 was never regenerated after those PRs and still embedded the pre-#379 prefixed Protocol shape plus the retired type-query/top-level-format Composition shape. No field/type/protocol/lifecycle/view semantic content changed here; package/ is byte-for-byte identical to 1.2.0/package except this description and the version bump below.
